name: Japan Cup (Tokyo 2400m Turf)
notes: Long final straight (~525m). Late surgers and end closers with strong final-leg skills dominate. Stamina ~550+ recommended.

name: Arima Kinen (Nakayama 2500m Turf)
notes: Right-handed, sharp slope before the final straight. Short straight (~310m) — positioning + acceleration matters more than top-end speed.

name: Tenno Sho Spring (Kyoto 3200m Turf)
notes: Longest classic. Stamina-heavy build (650+). McQueen-style late surgers shine.

name: Yasuda Kinen (Tokyo 1600m Turf)
notes: Mile classic on Tokyo. Front runners and pace chasers with mile aptitude dominate.

name: Takamatsunomiya Kinen (Chukyo 1200m Turf)
notes: Sprint classic. Front runner with high power + early-leg acceleration wins.

name: February Stakes (Tokyo 1600m Dirt)
notes: Dirt mile. Few umas have dirt A — pick wisely (Vodka, El Condor, Smart Falcon).

name: Satsuki Sho (Nakayama 2000m Turf)
notes: Classic medium. Right-handed, slope before straight. Balanced builds suited.
